name: local-documents
description: Read PDF, Word and Excel files, edit Excel workbooks, and organise files and folders — only inside folders you choose.
long_description:
Local Documents works only with files inside the folders you choose during setup. It cannot read or change anything outside them.

- **PDF**: Extract text, inspect document details, and render pages as images, including scanned pages.
- **Word (.docx)**: Read text and tables, inspect document structure, and search for content.
- **Excel (.xlsx, .xlsm)**: Read and search spreadsheets, inspect formulas, and edit cell values, formulas and worksheets.
- **File organisation**: Browse folders, create folders, and move or rename files and folders, individually or in batches.

**Designed to protect your files**

- Excel edits are saved to a new workbook by default. The original is overwritten only when you explicitly ask for it.
- Unrelated workbook content, including charts, pivot tables and macros, is preserved.
- Moving and renaming never overwrites or deletes existing files. If a batch move fails partway, completed moves are rolled back.
- Access is restricted to your selected folders, with protection against symbolic links and path traversal.

Supports macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64). No Python, Microsoft Office or other external applications required.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Get page count, metadata, page sizes, and whether a PDF has a text layer.

tools.name: pdf_read_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF's existing text layer, optionally for selected pages.

tools.name: pdf_render_page
tools.description: Render a PDF page to an image (for scanned or visual pages).

tools.name: xlsx_info
tools.description: List worksheets, used ranges, defined names, and workbook properties.

tools.name: xlsx_read_range
tools.description: Read cell values from a worksheet range.

tools.name: xlsx_search
tools.description: Find cells containing text across sheets.

tools.name: xlsx_edit
tools.description: Transactionally set cell values/formulas, clear cells and add sheets in an .xlsx/.xlsm, preserving unrelated content such as charts, pivot tables and macros.

tools.name: docx_info
tools.description: Get a Word document's properties, heading outline, tables and counts.

tools.name: docx_read_text
tools.description: Read a Word document as Markdown in reading order (headings, lists, tables, notes).

tools.name: docx_read_tables
tools.description: Extract a Word document's tables, including merged cells.

tools.name: docx_search
tools.description: Find text in a Word document with its location.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List a folder's files and subfolders with sizes and dates, optionally recursively.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder (optionally with missing parents).

tools.name: rename
tools.description: Rename a file or folder in place, without overwriting.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move a file or folder, without overwriting.

tools.name: move_batch
tools.description: Move and rename many files and folders in one all-or-nothing call.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders Claude may access, including subfolders. Claude can read supported documents, edit Excel workbooks, and organise files within these folders only.
